_readme: CSU Journal Finder — Agreement cap configuration. Edit this file and upload to GitHub to update cap warnings without touching index.html.

Wiley|Fully Open Access.label: Wiley Gold OA — agreement funding unavailable
Wiley|Fully Open Access.detail: CSU Library is treating the 2026 Wiley allocation for fully open access (Gold) journals as unavailable for the remainder of 2026. New articles are not expected to be funded through the agreement until January 2027. A 20% APC discount may apply if alternative funding is available. Wiley hybrid journals are unaffected.

Springer|Fully Open Access.label: Springer Nature OA — uncapped
Springer|Fully Open Access.detail: The Springer Nature agreement is uncapped for 2026–2028. A forecast pool applies to certain Springer and Palgrave Open fully OA titles, but publishing does not cease if the pool's maximum threshold is reached.

_status_values.ok: No cap warning — agreement is uncapped or cap not yet reached
_status_values.capped: Cap warning active — show amber warning badge on journal cards
_status_values.reached: Cap reached — show red warning badge, publishing no longer funded
_status_values.unavailable: Agreement funding unavailable — show red warning badge and exclude from free-to-publish results

_how_to_update: To clear a warning, change its status to 'ok'. Use 'capped' for a cap risk, 'reached' for confirmed exhaustion, or 'unavailable' when CSU Library is treating agreement funding as unavailable. Upload this file to your GitHub repo alongside index.html. Changes take effect within 2 minutes.
